summary: Agent loop calls Workers AI until the model says FINAL, with no iteration or token budget.

expected_findings.contains: const result = (await env.AI.run(MODEL, { messages })) as { response: string };
expected_findings.explanation: The while (true) loop only exits when the model replies FINAL. There is no maximum iteration count, token budget or max_tokens, and the message history grows every turn, so each call costs more Neurons than the last. Any unauthenticated request can start it, and a question the model never finalizes runs until the request is cut off.
